# Gymodoro

> Gymodoro (gymodoro.com) is a free Pomodoro focus timer that turns every break into a workout. You work in 25-minute focus blocks; when the timer rings, Gymodoro gives you a guided 5-minute exercise (with demo video, muscle diagram and instructions) to do at your desk instead of scrolling your phone.

Gymodoro is a web app for students, remote workers and anyone who sits at a desk. It is not related to Comodoro (the city in Argentina) or to any other product with a similar name.

## Key facts
- Category: productivity timer + fitness app (Pomodoro technique with active breaks)
- Price: free to start
- Platform: web browser, no install
- Default cycle: 25 minutes focus, 5 minutes active break, 15-minute long break after four rounds
- Exercise library: 160+ bodyweight exercises with video demos and muscle diagrams
- Also includes: daily stats (focus time, active breaks, calories burned), scenic wallpapers, selectable timer ring sounds
